title: A generalized Livšic--Sinai Theorem for endomorphisms
summary: The classical theorem of Livšic and Sinai states that a transitive $C^2$ Anosov diffeomorphism whose Jacobian along every periodic orbit equals one admits an invariant volume form. Recently, it was observed that the periodic Jacobian condition alone already implies transitivity, rendering the transitivity assumption unnecessary. We extend this rigidity phenomenon to the non-invertible setting.
